title: SUMB - Software Update Menu Bar (fr.jeremyb.sumb)
description: Managed settings for SUMB, a companion menu bar app for scheduled macOS updates deployed via blueprints/DDM. Preference domain: fr.jeremyb.sumb. Requires macOS 15.0 or later.

hideIconWhenUpToDate.title: Hide Menu Bar Icon When Up to Date
hideIconWhenUpToDate.description: Remove the SUMB icon from the menu bar when the Mac is up to date.

hideSettings.title: Disable Settings
hideSettings.description: Hide the Settings menu. Holding Option while right-clicking the menu bar icon still reveals it, as does relaunching SUMB.app.

ignoreAppleUpdateChannel.title: Ignore Apple Update Channel
ignoreAppleUpdateChannel.description: Ignore updates from the standard Apple software update channel; only take managed update declarations (DDM) into account.

menubarDotBlinkingThresholdDays.title: Dot Blinking (days)
menubarDotBlinkingThresholdDays.description: Number of days before the update deadline at which the red dot on the menu bar icon starts blinking. 0 turns blinking off.

menubarPrefix.title: Day Prefix
menubarPrefix.description: Text placed before the number of days remaining in the menu bar countdown.

menubarPreparingMessage.title: Updating Menu Bar Text
menubarPreparingMessage.description: Text shown in the menu bar while the update is being prepared.

menubarSuffix.title: Day Suffix
menubarSuffix.description: Text placed after the number of days remaining (e.g. "j" in French, "t" in German).

notificationBody.title: Reminder Notification Body
notificationBody.description: Body text of the reminder notification. Supports $VERSION, $DATE and $COUNTDOWN variables.
notificationBody.default: An update to macOS $VERSION has been scheduled for $DATE.

notificationIntervalMinutes.title: Reminder Interval (minutes)
notificationIntervalMinutes.description: Time in minutes between two reminder notifications. (min: 1)

notificationSound.title: Alert Sound
notificationSound.description: Alert sound, played with the notification and the Scheduler popup. Type only the filename with its extension, not the full path. Leave empty for the system default tone. Only files located in /System/Library/Sounds are supported (e.g., Blow.aiff Sosumi.aiff Morse.aiff).

options.infoText: Key name: notificationSound - a file name from /System/Library/Sounds

notificationThresholdDays.title: Reminder Threshold (days)
notificationThresholdDays.description: Days remaining before the update deadline at which SUMB starts sending reminder notifications. (min: 0)

notificationTitle.title: Reminder Notification Title
notificationTitle.description: Title displayed in the reminder notification. Supports $VERSION, $DATE and $COUNTDOWN variables.

notificationsEnabled.title: Enable Notifications
notificationsEnabled.description: Allow SUMB to post reminder notifications about the scheduled macOS update.

popoverFooter.title: Restart Warning
popoverFooter.description: Warning at the bottom of the popover. Supports Markdown links: [text](https://example.com)

popoverTitle.title: Popover Title
popoverTitle.description: Title shown at the top of the popover.

popoverUpToDateMessage.title: Up to Date Message
popoverUpToDateMessage.description: Message displayed in the popover when the Mac is up to date.
popoverUpToDateMessage.default: Your Mac is up to date.

popoverUpdateButton.title: Update Now Button Label
popoverUpdateButton.description: Label of the button that takes the user to Software Update.

popupBody.title: Scheduler Popup Message
popupBody.description: Message of the Scheduler popup. Supports $VERSION, $DATE and $COUNTDOWN variables.
popupBody.default: An update to macOS $VERSION has been scheduled for $DATE.

popupCal1MondayHours.title: Suggested Hours Monday
popupCal1MondayHours.description: Hours suggested on Monday, comma-separated from 0 to 23. 12,17 suggests 12h00 and 17h00.

popupCal2TuesdayHours.title: Suggested Hours Tuesday
popupCal2TuesdayHours.description: Hours suggested on Tuesday, comma-separated from 0 to 23. 12,17 suggests 12h00 and 17h00.

popupCal3WednesdayHours.title: Suggested Hours Wednesday
popupCal3WednesdayHours.description: Hours suggested on Wednesday, comma-separated from 0 to 23. 12,17 suggests 12h00 and 17h00.

popupCal4ThursdayHours.title: Suggested Hours Thursday
popupCal4ThursdayHours.description: Hours suggested on Thursday, comma-separated from 0 to 23. 12,17 suggests 12h00 and 17h00.

popupCal5FridayHours.title: Suggested Hours Friday
popupCal5FridayHours.description: Hours suggested on Friday, comma-separated from 0 to 23. 12,17 suggests 12h00 and 17h00.

popupCal6SaturdayHours.title: Suggested Hours Saturday
popupCal6SaturdayHours.description: Hours suggested on Saturday, comma-separated from 0 to 23.

popupCal7SundayHours.title: Suggested Hours Sunday
popupCal7SundayHours.description: Hours suggested on Sunday, comma-separated from 0 to 23.

popupEnabled.title: Enable Popup Reminders
popupEnabled.description: Show the popup reminder at the start of each allowed hour.

popupRescheduleButton.title: Scheduler Reschedule Button
popupRescheduleButton.description: Label of button that opens the Scheduler window.

popupSchedulerHelp.title: Scheduler Help Text
popupSchedulerHelp.description: Instructions shown above the grid in the Scheduler window.
popupSchedulerHelp.default:
Please select the times you are available to update your Mac.
You will get one popup reminder per selected hour.

popupThresholdDays.title: Popup Reminder Threshold (days)
popupThresholdDays.description: Days remaining before the update deadline at which the Scheduler popup starts showing.

popupUpdateButton.title: Scheduler Update Now Button
popupUpdateButton.description: Label of the popup update button, opens Software Update.

showDockIcon.title: Show Dock Icon
showDockIcon.description: Show the SUMB icon in the Dock when an update is available.
